\section{Field Observations}
\label{sec:ch5-SI-field-data}

Every geotagged field observation of the July 2023 campaign is listed in
Table~\ref{tab:ch5-field-stations}, in order of stratigraphic height (as described in \S\ref{sec:ch5-stratigraphic-column-methods}) 
relative to the Merensky Reef ($h = 0$ m). The
table carries the location, the interpreted map unit and lithology, any
structural reading taken at the site, and the IDs of the photographs taken there.
Detailed, free-form field descriptions and notes are footnotes to the observations' names, at the
foot of the page. These field data are plotted on the lithological
and structural maps of Chapter~\ref{ch:draaikraal}
(Figures~\ref{fig:ch5-lithological-map} and~\ref{fig:ch5-structural-map}).

\ChFiveFieldStationTable

\section{Annotated Field Photographs}
\label{sec:ch5-SI-photo-album}

Selected field photographs are reproduced below with their captions, two to a
page, in numerical order; photographs taken in portrait orientation follow
the others. Photographs keep
their field numbers (DrBV$n$). Photo~\ChFivePhoto{60} is shown with an
interpretation of its deformation history in
Figure~\ref{fig:ch5-photo60-deformation}. The remaining field photographs, with
their captions, are in the supplementary photo album. Photo numbers in
Chapter~\ref{ch:draaikraal} and in Table~\ref{tab:ch5-field-stations} link to
the photograph when it is reproduced in this thesis, and are printed without a
link when they point to the supplement.
